name: shader programming
description: Shaders are small programs that run per vertex and per pixel on the GPU. The concepts — the pipeline, coordinate spaces, UVs, and how common effects are built — port across engines; only the language dialect and built-in variable names change. This skill teaches those portable fundamentals in GLSL with HLSL equivalents; use godot-shaders (or Unity/Unreal material docs) for the exact engine syntax
